title: Settings
subtitle: Restaurant-wide configuration. Changes save automatically and sync across devices.

openingHours.title: Opening hours
openingHours.description: When the restaurant is open each day. Used for reservation windows.

rules.title: Reservation rules
rules.description: When a booking may be placed.

latestBooking.label: Latest booking time
latestBooking.help: Latest clock time a booking may be made for. Leave blank for no cutoff.

minAdvance.label: Minimum advance
minAdvance.help: How far ahead a booking must be made.

allowAfterClosing.label: Allow bookings after closing
allowAfterClosing.help: Accept a booking for a time past the day's closing hour.

party.title: Guest & party rules
party.description: Accepted party sizes and how a party may be seated.

minSize.label: Minimum party size
minSize.help: Smallest party a booking may have.

maxSize.label: Maximum party size
maxSize.help: Largest party a booking may have.

maxCombined.label: Max combined tables
maxCombined.help: Most tables a single party may be merged across.

allowSplit.label: Allow splitting a party
allowSplit.help: Seat one party across several separate tables.

allowAltZone.label: Suggest alternative zones
allowAltZone.help: Let the seating engine offer a table outside the preferred zone.

defaults.title: Default values
defaults.description: Applied to a new booking unless overridden.

active.label: Closed to new bookings
active.help: No new reservations are accepted while this is on.

until.label: Reopen date
until.help: Leave blank to stay closed until turned off.

blocks.title: Blocked dates
blocks.description: Block a single date, or a time window within it.

floor.title: Floor
floor.description: Grid and drawing behaviour in the layout editor.

gridSize.label: Grid size
gridSize.help: Spacing of the editor grid, in world units.

snapToGrid.label: Snap to grid
snapToGrid.help: Tables and zones snap to the grid while dragging.

pathWidth.label: Keep-clear brush width
pathWidth.help: Default width of freehand keep-clear paths.

seating.title: Seating rules
seating.description: How the floor turns over and when a booking blocks a table.

autoTurnover.label: Automatic turnover
autoTurnover.help: A cleaning table returns to available on its own after the buffer.

turnoverBuffer.label: Turnover buffer
turnoverBuffer.help: Minutes reserved between two bookings on the same table.

defaultStay.label: Default stay
defaultStay.help: Stay time a new booking gets by default.

maxStay.label: Maximum stay
maxStay.help: Hard cap on how long a booking may hold a table.

reservedLookahead.label: Reserved look-ahead
reservedLookahead.help: A table reads reserved only once a booking is due within this window.

waitlist.label: Waiting list
waitlist.help: Show the waiting-list rail on the Live Floor.

bookedMark.label: Booked-table marker
bookedMark.help: Show a small mark on tables that hold a booking (reserved or upcoming). Per-device.

zones.title: Zone settings
zones.description: Per-zone policy. Create, rename, and arrange zones in the layout editor.
zones.empty: No zones yet. Add zones in the layout editor.

relocation.label: Allow moving tables in and out of {{zone}} for cross-zone merges

availability.title: Zone availability
availability.description: Turn a zone off to take it out of bookings without deleting it.
availability.label: {{zone}} open for bookings

staff.title: Team
staff.description: People with access to this restaurant.

removeConfirm.title: Remove member
removeConfirm.body: Remove {{name}} from this restaurant? They lose access immediately.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: What each role can do. Roles are fixed for now.

tableRules.title: Table rules
tableRules.description: How the seating engine combines tables and picks a fit.

crossZone.label: Allow cross-zone combining
crossZone.help: Let a merge borrow tables from another zone.

maxCombined.label: Max combined tables
maxCombined.help: Most tables one merge may span. Shared with Reservations.

maxUnderfill.label: Max empty seats
maxUnderfill.help: How many seats a table/merge may exceed the party by.

exactFit.label: Prefer a tight fit
exactFit.help: Weight toward the smallest table that fits (less wasted capacity).

fewer.label: Prefer fewer tables
fewer.help: Weight toward a single table over a merge when both fit.

preferredCombos.title: Preferred large-party combos
preferredCombos.description: For a big party in a zone, offer a specific table set first. A preference, not a rule — the engine can still fall back.

language.title: Language
language.description: Your display language. This preference is per person, not shared.
language.label: Display language

name.label: Restaurant name
name.help: Shown in the header and on invites.

timezone.label: Time zone
timezone.help: Used for scheduling. Leave blank to follow this device.
